result.title: Partial-Revelation Panel Forecasting: Predictive Information Gain, Allocation, and Coarsening-Consistent Operators
result.comment: 27 pages, 2 figures. Code and aggregate result summaries included as ancillary files
result.summary: We study partial-revelation panel forecasting: given $k$ of $n$ annotator votes on the previous dialogue turn, predict the full count distribution of the next turn's panel. This cross-turn predictive information differs from same-item annotation value. Under any nested revelation mechanism, the population decrement satisfies $V(k)-V(k+1)=I(Y;R_{k+1}\mid X_k)$; a fitted model also contributes adjacent excess-risk differences. Coarsened-completely-at-random (CCAR) masking supplies the exchangeable random-rater interpretation used in our operators. We define coarsening-consistent panel operators with a closed-form Dirichlet-multinomial realization, learned completion, and rater-count transfer. Against per-level lookup, cold-start count negative log-likelihood differences are -0.422/-0.166/-0.014 nats on IEMOCAP/M3ED/EmoWOZ. A held-out rater experiment measures same-item value: first and second additional votes reduce NLL by 0.583/0.221, 0.578/0.184, and 0.180/0.069 nats, respectively. Cross-turn and same-item gains are not interchangeable, and CCAR masks are controlled interventions rather than observed arrival processes. Consistency is auditable but does not guarantee predictive improvement; per-level marginalization can outperform a shared table. Target-free allocation beats uniform only where row-level signal is predictable: at budget one it recovers 83--93% of retrospective feature class headroom on IEMOCAP/M3ED but does not improve EmoWOZ. Gains are modest and corpus-dependent, with several small or null partial-revelation differences. Code and aggregate result artifacts accompany the preprint.

AI.brief_summary: 研究「部分揭示」面板预测：仅给前一轮 k 个标注者投票时预测下一轮完整计数分布，推导相邻信息增益等于条件互信息并计入风险差，提出带 Dirichlet-multinomial 闭式实现的一致性面板算子，在 IEMOCAP/M3ED/EmoWOZ 上测冷启动 NLL、同项投票价值与预算分配收益。
AI.relevance_reason: 其预测信息增益分解与「CCAR 掩码作为受控干预」的设计，可能为 LVR 中额外视觉证据的价值评估、latent 贡献审计及获取/停止决策提供借鉴线索；但任务域为对话标注面板，与视觉推理无直接关联，需较多核查。
